votes.sql:
WITH acct_stats AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt,
           AVG(balance) AS avg_bal
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(txn_cnt) AS avg_txn_cnt,
           AVG(avg_bal) AS avg_avg_bal
    FROM acct_stats
)
SELECT a.account_id
FROM acct_stats a
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE a.txn_cnt > o.avg_txn_cnt
  AND a.avg_bal > o.avg_avg_bal;

WITH account_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        a.account_id,
        COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_volume,
        AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM account a
    INNER JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id
)
SELECT account_id
FROM account_metrics
WHERE total_transaction_volume >= 100000 AND avg_balance >= 50000;

WITH national_avg AS (
        SELECT AVG(A13) AS avg_unemp
        FROM district
    ),
    eligible_districts AS (
        SELECT district_id
        FROM district, national_avg
        WHERE A13 > avg_unemp
    ),
    client_loans AS (
        SELECT c.client_id,
               COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans,
               SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A','C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_loans
        FROM client c
        JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
        JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
        WHERE c.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM eligible_districts)
        GROUP BY c.client_id
    )
SELECT cl.client_id,
       CASE WHEN cl.total_loans = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE CAST(cl.successful_loans AS REAL) / cl.total_loans
       END AS creditworthiness_index,
       CASE
           WHEN cl.total_loans = 0 THEN 'Bronze'
           WHEN (CAST(cl.successful_loans AS REAL) / cl.total_loans) >= 0.90 THEN 'Platinum'
           WHEN (CAST(cl.successful_loans AS REAL) / cl.total_loans) >= 0.75 THEN 'Gold'
           WHEN (CAST(cl.successful_loans AS REAL) / cl.total_loans) >= 0.50 THEN 'Silver'
           ELSE 'Bronze'
       END AS tier
FROM client_loans cl;

votes.sql:
SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    ROUND(SUM(l.amount) * 0.85, 2) AS total_repayment_eur,
    CASE 
        WHEN d.A11 >= 10000 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN d.A11 >= 8000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS risk_rating
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'
  AND l.date >= DATE('now','-3 years')
GROUP BY c.client_id, d.A2, d.A11
ORDER BY total_repayment_eur DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT cl.client_id, d.A2, SUM(lo.amount) * 0.9 AS total_repayment_euros, CASE WHEN d.A11 >= 12500 THEN 'Low' WHEN d.A11 >= 9000 AND d.A11 < 12500 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS risk_rating FROM client cl JOIN district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN loan lo ON dp.account_id = lo.account_id WHERE lo.status = 'A' GROUP BY cl.client_id, d.district_id ORDER BY total_repayment_euros DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    dist.A2 AS district_name,
    SUM(l.amount) * 0.9 AS total_repayment_euros,
    CASE
        WHEN dist.A11 >= 10000 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN dist.A11 >= 8000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS risk_rating
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE l.date >= (SELECT date(MAX(date), '-3 years') FROM loan)
GROUP BY c.client_id, dist.A2, dist.A11
ORDER BY total_repayment_euros DESC
LIMIT 10;

votes.sql:
WITH withdrawals AS (
    SELECT a.district_id,
           SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND substr(t.date, 1, 4) = '1998'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
defaulted_loans AS (
    SELECT a.district_id,
           COUNT(l.loan_id) AS defaulted_cnt
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.status IN ('B', 'D')
      AND substr(l.date, 1, 4) = '1998'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
)
SELECT d.A2 AS region,
       (COALESCE(w.total_withdrawal, 0) / d.A4) * (d.A10 / 100.0) +
       (COALESCE(dl.defaulted_cnt, 0) / d.A4) * d.A14 AS financial_stability_index,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           ORDER BY ((COALESCE(w.total_withdrawal, 0) / d.A4) * (d.A10 / 100.0) +
                     (COALESCE(dl.defaulted_cnt, 0) / d.A4) * d.A14) DESC
       ) AS rank
FROM district d
LEFT JOIN withdrawals w ON d.district_id = w.district_id
LEFT JOIN defaulted_loans dl ON d.district_id = dl.district_id
ORDER BY financial_stability_index DESC;

        a.district_id,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_cash_withdrawals
    FROM account a
    JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'

      AND t.operation IN ('VYBER', 'VYBER KARTOU')
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
district_loan_defaults AS (
    SELECT 
        a.district_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('B', 'D') THEN 1 END) AS defaulted_loan_count
    FROM account a
    JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1998'
      AND l.status IN ('B', 'D')
    GROUP BY a.district_id
)
SELECT 
    d.A3,
    ROUND(COALESCE(CAST(cw.total_cash_withdrawals AS REAL) / NULLIF(d.A4, 0), 0) * 0.4 + 
          COALESCE(CAST(ld.defaulted_loan_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(d.A4, 0), 0) * 0.6, 6) AS financial_stability_index
FROM district d
LEFT JOIN district_cash_withdrawals cw ON d.district_id = cw.district_id
LEFT JOIN district_loan_defaults ld ON d.district_id = ld.district_id
ORDER BY financial_stability_index DESC

judgments.rationale:
The Natural Language Question asks to "Compute the annual percentage rate (APR) for each loan". The Annual Percentage Rate is a standardized measure of the cost of borrowing, typically calculated using the Internal Rate of Return (IRR) method which accounts for the time value of money and compounding of payments over the loan duration.

The Candidate SQL Query calculates the rate using the formula: `((payments * duration / amount) - 1) * (12.0 / duration) * 100.0`.
This formula calculates the total interest paid divided by the principal, then annualized linearly.
1.  `payments * duration` = Total repayment amount.
2.  `Total repayment / amount` = Total capital return ratio.
3.  `Ratio - 1` = Total interest ratio over the full term.
4.  `* (12.0 / duration)` = Annualizes this ratio assuming simple interest.

This calculation corresponds to a **Simple Interest Rate** (or flat rate), not the **Annual Percentage Rate (APR)**. True APR calculation requires solving for the discount rate in an annuity equation, which involves non-linear calculations (roots finding) not supported by standard SQL arithmetic without recursive approaches.

votes.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id,
       c.gender,
       d.A2 AS district_name
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE a.date <= date('now','-5 years')
  AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0)
       FROM trans t
       WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id) >= 10000
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                  FROM loan l
                  WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id
                    AND l.status IN ('B','D'))

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender, c.district_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'
ORDER BY c.client_id

WITH client_accounts AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.district_id,
           a.account_id,
           a.date AS account_date
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
),
client_stats AS (
    SELECT ca.client_id,
           ca.gender,
           ca.district_id,
           (julianday((SELECT MAX(date) FROM account)) - julianday(MIN(ca.account_date))) AS account_age_days,
           COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0) AS total_txn_volume,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM disp d2
               JOIN loan l ON d2.account_id = l.account_id
               WHERE d2.client_id = ca.client_id AND l.status <> 'A'
           ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS good_loan_flag
    FROM client_accounts ca
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON ca.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY ca.client_id, ca.gender, ca.district_id
)
SELECT cs.client_id,
       cs.gender,
       d.A2 AS district_name
FROM client_stats cs
JOIN district d ON cs.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE cs.account_age_days > 365*2
  AND cs.total_txn_volume > 5000
  AND cs.good_loan_flag = 1;

votes.sql:
WITH gold_cards AS (
    SELECT
        c.card_id,
        d.account_id,
        dist.district_id,
        dist.A2 AS district_name,
        MAX(CASE WHEN l.amount > dist.A11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_qualifying
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
    JOIN district dist ON cl.district_id = dist.district_id
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
    GROUP BY c.card_id, dist.district_id, dist.A2
)
SELECT
    district_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT card_id) AS total_gold,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(has_qualifying) / COUNT(DISTINCT card_id), 2) AS percentage
FROM gold_cards
GROUP BY district_id, district_name
ORDER BY percentage DESC;

    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE cr.type = 'gold'
),
qualifying_loans AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        gch.card_id,
        gch.district_id
    FROM gold_cardholders gch
    JOIN loan l ON gch.card_id IN (
        SELECT cr2.card_id 
        FROM card cr2 
        JOIN disp dp2 ON cr2.disp_id = dp2.disp_id 
        WHERE dp2.account_id = gch.account_id
    )
    WHERE l.amount > gch.avg_salary
)
SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gch.card_id) AS total_gold_count,
    ROUND(
        CAST((
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ql.card_id) 
            FROM qualifying_loans ql 
            WHERE ql.district_id = gch.district_id
        ) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT gch.card_id),
        2
    ) AS percentage_above_salary
FROM gold_cardholders gch
JOIN district d ON gch.district_id = d.district_id
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY percentage_above_salary DESC

    ds."A2" AS district_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.client_id) AS total_gold_users,

ORDER BY percentage_above_avg DESC;

WITH owner_accounts AS (
        SELECT client_id, account_id
        FROM disp
        WHERE type = 'OWNER'
    ),
    latest_balances AS (
        SELECT t.account_id, t.balance
        FROM trans t
        JOIN (
            SELECT account_id, max(date) AS max_date
            FROM trans
            GROUP BY account_id
        ) m ON t.account_id = m.account_id AND t.date = m.max_date
    ),
    client_balance AS (
        SELECT oa.client_id,
               SUM(lb.balance) AS total_balance
        FROM owner_accounts oa
        LEFT JOIN latest_balances lb ON oa.account_id = lb.account_id
        GROUP BY oa.client_id
    ),
    client_transactions AS (
        SELECT oa.client_id,
               COUNT(t.trans_id) AS tx_count
        FROM owner_accounts oa
        LEFT JOIN trans t ON oa.account_id = t.account_id
        GROUP BY oa.client_id
    ),
    client_loan_points AS (
        SELECT oa.client_id,
               SUM(CASE l.status
                        WHEN 'A' THEN 20
                        WHEN 'C' THEN 10
                        WHEN 'B' THEN -30
                        WHEN 'D' THEN -50
                        ELSE 0
                   END) AS loan_points
        FROM owner_accounts oa
        LEFT JOIN loan l ON oa.account_id = l.account_id
        GROUP BY oa.client_id
    ),
    client_scores AS (
        SELECT c.client_id,
               600
               + COALESCE(lp.loan_points, 0)
               + COALESCE(t.tx_count, 0) * 0.5
               + COALESCE(b.total_balance, 0) / 1000.0 AS score
        FROM client c
        LEFT JOIN client_loan_points lp ON c.client_id = lp.client_id
        LEFT JOIN client_transactions t ON c.client_id = t.client_id
        LEFT JOIN client_balance b ON c.client_id = b.client_id
    )
SELECT client_id AS client_id,
       score
FROM client_scores
WHERE score >= 750
ORDER BY score DESC;

WITH client_account_mapping AS (
    SELECT 
        d.client_id,
        d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
client_loan_status AS (
    SELECT 
        cam.client_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 100 ELSE 0 END) AS loan_score
    FROM client_account_mapping cam
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON cam.account_id = l.account_id
    GROUP BY cam.client_id
),
client_transaction_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        cam.client_id,
        COUNT(t.trans_id) * 5 AS trans_score,
        AVG(t.balance) * 0.01 AS balance_score
    FROM client_account_mapping cam
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON cam.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY cam.client_id
),
client_final_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        clm.client_id,
        ROUND(
            COALESCE(cloans.loan_score, 0) + 
            COALESCE(ctstat.trans_score, 0) + 
            COALESCE(ctstat.balance_score, 0)
        ) AS credit_score
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT client_id FROM client_account_mapping
    ) clm
    LEFT JOIN client_loan_status cloans ON clm.client_id = cloans.client_id
    LEFT JOIN client_transaction_stats ctstat ON clm.client_id = ctstat.client_id
)
SELECT client_id, credit_score
FROM client_final_scores
WHERE credit_score >= 750;

WITH loan_agg AS (
    SELECT d.client_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A','C') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS good_loan_amt,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('B','D') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loan_amt
    FROM disp d
    JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
    GROUP BY d.client_id
),
trans_agg AS (
    SELECT d.client_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS credit_amt,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS debit_amt,
           AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM disp d
    JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY d.client_id
),
client_score AS (
    SELECT c.client_id,
           300 
           + COALESCE(la.good_loan_amt,0)/1000.0 * 20 
           - COALESCE(la.bad_loan_amt,0)/1000.0 * 30 
           + COALESCE(ta.avg_balance,0)/1000.0 * 10 
           + COALESCE(ta.credit_amt,0)/1000.0 * 5 
           - COALESCE(ta.debit_amt,0)/1000.0 * 5 AS fico_score
    FROM client c
    LEFT JOIN loan_agg la ON c.client_id = la.client_id
    LEFT JOIN trans_agg ta ON c.client_id = ta.client_id
)
SELECT client_id AS name, fico_score AS score
FROM client_score
WHERE fico_score >= 750;

SELECT a.account_id,
       a.district_id,
       a.frequency,
       a.date,
       SUM(t.amount) AS total_moved
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold'
GROUP BY a.account_id
ORDER BY total_moved DESC;

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency, a.date
    FROM "account" a
    JOIN "disp" d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN "card" c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
)
SELECT ga.account_id, ga.district_id, ga.frequency, ga.date,
       COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_moved
FROM gold_accounts ga
LEFT JOIN "trans" t ON ga.account_id = t.account_id
GROUP BY ga.account_id, ga.district_id, ga.frequency, ga.date
ORDER BY total_moved DESC;

WITH client_accounts AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, a.account_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
),
trans_stats AS (
    SELECT ca.client_id,
           AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.balance < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_balance_count
    FROM client_accounts ca
    JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = ca.account_id
    GROUP BY ca.client_id
),
loan_stats AS (
    SELECT ca.client_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('B','D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loan_flag,
           MAX(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS running_loan_flag
    FROM client_accounts ca
    JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = ca.account_id
    GROUP BY ca.client_id
)
SELECT
    c.client_id,
    CASE
        WHEN (COALESCE(ls.bad_loan_flag,0) * 3 +
              COALESCE(ls.running_loan_flag,0) * 2 +
              CASE WHEN COALESCE(ts.avg_balance,0) < 0 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
              CASE WHEN COALESCE(ts.negative_balance_count,0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5 THEN 'High'
        WHEN (COALESCE(ls.bad_loan_flag,0) * 3 +
              COALESCE(ls.running_loan_flag,0) * 2 +
              CASE WHEN COALESCE(ts.avg_balance,0) < 0 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
              CASE WHEN COALESCE(ts.negative_balance_count,0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS credit_risk_level
FROM client c
LEFT JOIN trans_stats ts ON ts.client_id = c.client_id
LEFT JOIN loan_stats ls ON ls.client_id = c.client_id;

votes.sql:
WITH client_bal AS (
        SELECT c.client_id, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_bal
        FROM client c
        JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
        JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
        GROUP BY c.client_id
    ),
    premium_threshold AS (
        SELECT AVG(avg_bal) AS thresh FROM client_bal
    ),
    client_loans AS (
        SELECT c.client_id, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS successful_loans
        FROM client c
        JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
        JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
        WHERE l.status = 'A'
        GROUP BY c.client_id
    )
SELECT cb.client_id
FROM client_bal cb
CROSS JOIN premium_threshold pt
JOIN client_loans cl ON cl.client_id = cb.client_id
WHERE cb.avg_bal > pt.thresh
  AND cl.successful_loans >= 2;

WITH client_avg_balance AS (
    SELECT d.client_id, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM disp d
    JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY d.client_id
),
client_successful_loans AS (
    SELECT d.client_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS successful_loan_count
    FROM disp d
    JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.status = 'A'
    GROUP BY d.client_id
)
SELECT cb.client_id
FROM client_avg_balance cb
JOIN client_successful_loans csl ON cb.client_id = csl.client_id
WHERE cb.avg_balance > 10000
    AND csl.successful_loan_count >= 2

WITH client_balances AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY c.client_id
),
client_loans AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, COUNT(*) AS successful_loans
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.status = 'A'
    GROUP BY c.client_id
)
SELECT cb.client_id
FROM client_balances cb
JOIN client_loans cl ON cb.client_id = cl.client_id
WHERE cb.avg_balance > (SELECT AVG(balance) FROM trans)
  AND cl.successful_loans >= 2;

    SELECT c.client_id, SUM(t.amount) AS trans_volume
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id

    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    GROUP BY c.client_id
)
SELECT ta.client_id
FROM trans_agg ta
JOIN loan_agg la ON ta.client_id = la.client_id
WHERE ta.trans_volume > (SELECT AVG(trans_volume) FROM trans_agg)
  AND la.loan_repayment > (SELECT AVG(loan_repayment) FROM loan_agg);
